system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — VeriFone (Verifone) realized record after go-private, ~3–5-year horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the company was taken private and
> deregistered, there is no post-closing public 10-K; the realized record is traced
> through the company's own press releases and reputable press. This sub-dossier contains
> no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- The Company's last annual report on Form 10-K on EDGAR covers the fiscal year ended
  October 31, 2017 and was filed December 18, 2017, before the merger closed; no
  subsequent Form 10-K or Form 20-F appears in the Company's EDGAR filing history.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001312073-17-000047, Form 10-K]
- On August 30, 2018, VeriFone Systems, Inc. filed a Form 15-12B certifying termination
  of registration of its common stock under the Exchange Act, reporting approximately
  one (1) holder of record as of the certification date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-262531, Form 15-12B]
- No annual report or other periodic report was filed by the Company after the Form
  15-12B; consequently no audited public financial statements exist for the company on
  EDGAR covering the ~2021–2023 outcome window, and the realized-record facts below rely
  on company press releases rather than primary SEC filings.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-262531, Form 15-12B]

## Realized business record under private ownership (press-sourced)
- Under private ownership the company (styled "Verifone") described itself, in a 2023
  release, as employing more than 4,500 "payments architects and commerce experts,"
  operating gateways that process more than 14 billion transactions annually, and
  maintaining an ecosystem of 2,500-plus integrations.
  [SRC: https://www.verifone.com/resources/verifone-announces-new-industry-veteran-ceo]
- The company experienced rapid chief-executive turnover in 2023: Mike Kohlsdorf became
  CEO in August 2023, focused during his tenure on "enhancing employee, customer and
  shareholder satisfaction, as well as broadening current partnerships and starting new
  ones," and was succeeded as CEO by Himanshu Patel effective November 1, 2023 — an
  interval of approximately three months — with Kohlsdorf remaining on the company's
  board of directors. [SRC: https://www.verifone.com/resources/verifone-announces-new-industry-veteran-ceo]
- On April 1, 2025 (beyond the ~3–5-year window), the company announced a $235 million
  preferred-equity investment from Francisco Partners, British Columbia Investment
  Management Corporation (BCI), and other existing shareholders, together with
  extensions of its Revolving Credit, Term Loan, and Accounts Receivable Securitization
  facilities; a Francisco Partners representative stated the company was "well
  positioned for sustained success and growth," and the company's CFO stated the
  financing provided "a strong, stable balance sheet."
  [SRC: https://www.verifone.com/resources/press-room-article-verifone-receives-equity-investment]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- Third-party aggregators report post-privatization revenue figures for the company
  (e.g., stated revenue movement for 2021 and 2022), but these are not traceable to
  audited primary financial statements and are recorded here as [UNVERIFIED]. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the company was taken private and its Exchange Act registration terminated in
  August 2018, there is no public audited outcome record on EDGAR for the ~2021–2023
  window; the traceable realized record is limited to company press disclosures showing
  a business that continued to operate at global scale in 2023 (4,500+ employees; 14B+
  annual gateway transactions; 2,500+ integrations) but exhibited leadership instability
  (a CEO transition after roughly three months in 2023) and, by 2025, drew a $235 million
  shareholder equity injection alongside debt-facility extensions.
  [SRC: https://www.verifone.com/resources/verifone-announces-new-industry-veteran-ceo] [SRC: https://www.verifone.com/resources/press-room-article-verifone-receives-equity-investment]

[SLICE END]
